Name: The Planter for All Occasions
Author: brightonmorris1
Description:
[b][size=4]Behold, the mighty seasonal planter![/size][/b][size=3] It combines all my previous mods and has had significant improvements all-around. All recipes have been consolidated onto a single machine, it no longer needs sap to function, [/size][u]all fertilizer types are now supported[/u][size=3], [i]and [/i]it has custom graphics for all outputs and inputs. 
[/size]
[size=3]The art is also seasonal, to help remind you what crops the planter box will allow: it even tells you if you're in an indoor area. 

It grows all types of seasonal forage, most of the aquatic forage, and all of the forage found in caves. 

Forage clippings come from putting the plant into a seed maker (so technically it's also locked until your farming level is high enough).

The planter box is still considered a "machine" in the game's code, so they consume fertilizer in your backpack when you place the seed in the machine (similar to how a furnace just automatically consumes coal from your inventory). Boxes prioritize checks like this: fertilizer > speed gro > retaining soil. After it finds one, it will also try to use the lowest quality one first.

Retaining soil maxes out the output, so it always rolls the highest amount of crops. The other two fertilizer types function exactly how you think they would.

It plays nicely with [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5038]PFM Automate[/url],﻿ but it's not required at all and the mod works fine without it.[/size]

[size=3][b]Important: The recipe is now unlocked via a cutscene that happens when you reach 6 hearts with Evelyn and it's a clear day in town. She also explains how to use it if my rambling in the description isn't good enough.
[/b][/size][size=1]
[s]Also I definitely didn't add any Easter eggs.[/s][/size]
